title: PAP step-scoped control overlap
hypothesis: PAP can overlap step-level control and metadata preparation with Projection QKV computation without changing batch order or regressing decode performance.

reasons: This is one clean targeted development repetition; release-level evidence still requires three interleaved repetitions.
The initial-burst TTFT p95 moved adversely while mean, p90, and p99 do not show a consistent tail regression.

baseline.description: Accepted C12 scheduler-overlap run from PAP-20260724-PROJECTION-SCHEDULER-OVERLAP

treatment.description: PAP 3PA1P C12 with route-plan preparation, Attention step preparation, and independent multi-PA output streams

primary_variable.name: step-control-overlap
primary_variable.treatment: step preparation plus peer-local output streams

aggregation_method: Single complete clean treatment repetition compared with the accepted prior C12 development baseline
conclusion: The clean C12 run completed 320/320 requests and reused every prepared context across all 36 layers. Mean ITL improves 0.37%, ITL p95 improves 5.19%, and throughput improves 0.50%; accept the implementation while treating the isolated initial-burst TTFT p95 movement as inconclusive.
